GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-12-30T19:34:08Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Deserialize arguments to a type with private constructor
Description: In the following example, my `Test` model has a parameterless private constructor. That's why it throws an exception saying, `System.MissingMethodException: 'No parameterless constructor defined for this object.'` while deserializing the arguments to the specified type.

```
Field<TestType>("test", "create test",
                arguments: new QueryArguments(
                    new QueryArgument<NonNullGraphType<TestInputType>> {Name = "test", Description = "test input"}
                ),
                resolve: context =>
                {
                    var test = context.GetArgument<Test>("test");
                    return repository.AddAsync(test);
                });
```

Question: Is there any way to make it work while keeping the parameterless constructor private?

N.B: Json.Net can handle non public default constructor for deserialization i.e.  
```
JsonSerializerSettings settings = new JsonSerializerSettings 
{ 
    ConstructorHandling = ConstructorHandling.AllowNonPublicDefaultConstructor 
};
```

You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
